children: The Thai hospital sector will likely post stronger results in 2H compared with 1H, thanks to factors including a rise in respiratory cases and pent-up demand from the Middle East, say DBS Group Research analysts in a note. A respiratory illness outbreak in 3Q is likely to support Thai patient revenue recovery, they say, noting that combined influenza, Covid-19 and respiratory syncytial virus cases grew around 48% from a year earlier over the July to August period. Pent-up demand from Middle East patients and the normalization of Cambodian patient revenue from a low base starting in July should bolster the Thai hospital sector, the analysts add. The sector's valuation remains attractive at around 19.4X 2026 price-to-earnings ratio. DBS's top picks include Bumrungrad Hospital and Praram 9 Hospital. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
